notes: Three English *that*s go to the one לְמַעַן under rule 55's last clause; the contract's own לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר example shows the waws keep only the connective they are rendered by even where a *that* stands immediately after one.
בְתוֹכָהּ → *in it* splits with תָּוֶךְ unrepresented, contrasting with the verse's other בְּתוֹךְ, which the ASV writes out as *in the midst of it*.
